scoring_justification: Recompute from raw artifacts is infeasible because the checker cannot rerun DFT relaxation. Symmetric tolerance on each reported value measures reproduction accuracy.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold numeric values for structural parameters and energy differences
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Bi-Bi 3.07 Å, Bi-As 2.73 Å, vertical Bi-As 2.68 Å, As-rest displacement 0.35 Å, Ga-As compression 0.03 Å; T4 vs H3 0.12 eV/trimer, c4x2 vs 2x2 0.06 eV/trimer.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted directly from the paper's reported equilibrium geometry and total-energy comparison.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These values are the authoritative paper-reported results for the main claim.

outputs.description: Five structural parameters of the relaxed c(4×2) surface: Bi-Bi bond length, Bi-As bond length, vertical Bi-As separation, As rest atom upward displacement, and Ga-As bond compression beneath Bi trimers.
Two energy differences: (a) T4 vs H3 adsorption site preference per trimer, and (b) c(4×2) vs (2×2) reconstruction stability per trimer.

output_contract.notes: Removed the extraneous band_gap_eV field to align with the hidden checker that does not score it.
